item.title: [OrangePi] Fixing wrong colours on the MPI3501 3.5 inch TFT screen
item.description: I have an Orange pi zero 2w board, which can be seen as a higher-performance yet cheaper version of the Raspberry Pi Zero 2w. The trade-off is less documentation and less support. I felt this deeply when I ran into a problem where the screen on the board displayed the wrong colours
